create_inbox.description: Make a new throwaway email address that receives real mail straight away. Use it to sign up for something, test your own emails, or catch a verification code, then read what arrives with the other steps. The address is random and is deleted when its time runs out.
create_inbox.name: create_inbox

parameters.description: Optional. The part after the @. Leave blank for a random one.
parameters.name: domain

parameters.description: How long the inbox lasts before it and its emails are deleted, between 10 and 120 minutes.
parameters.name: lifetime_minutes

address.description: The temporary email address. Mail sent to it arrives here.

created_at.description: When the inbox was made (UTC, ISO 8601).

domain.description: The part of the address after the @.

expires_at.description: When the inbox and everything in it is deleted (UTC).

minutes_left.description: Whole minutes until the inbox expires.

delete_inbox.description: Delete a temporary inbox and its emails now, before its time runs out. The address stops receiving mail.
delete_inbox.name: delete_inbox

parameters.description: The temporary email address to use. Pick the address from an earlier 'Create a temporary inbox' step.
parameters.name: address

get_inbox.description: Check a temporary inbox: when it was made, how long it has left and how many emails it holds. Fails if the inbox has expired or been deleted.
get_inbox.name: get_inbox

parameters.description: The temporary email address to use. Pick the address from an earlier 'Create a temporary inbox' step.
parameters.name: address

address.description: The temporary email address. Mail sent to it arrives here.

created_at.description: When the inbox was made (UTC, ISO 8601).

domain.description: The part of the address after the @.

email_count.description: How many emails are in the inbox.

expires_at.description: When the inbox and everything in it is deleted (UTC).

minutes_left.description: Whole minutes until the inbox expires.

get_service_status.description: Check that Best Temp Mail is up before relying on it, and see how many inboxes are in use and which domains are on offer.
get_service_status.display_str_template: Check whether Best Temp Mail is working.
get_service_status.name: get_service_status

active_inboxes.description: How many temporary inboxes are open now.

domains.description: The domains new inboxes can use.

inboxes_created_all_time.description: How many inboxes the service has ever made.

online.description: Whether the service says it is working.

status.description: The service's own status word, ok when well.

list_domains.description: Get the domains (the part after the @) that new temporary inboxes can use right now. The list changes from time to time.
list_domains.display_str_template: List the domains temporary inboxes can use.
list_domains.name: list_domains

list_emails.description: See every email in a temporary inbox, newest first: who sent it, the subject and when it arrived.

emails.subject: Action Required: Activate FormSubmit on https://example.com/

list_emails.name: list_emails

parameters.description: The temporary email address to use. Pick the address from an earlier 'Create a temporary inbox' step.
parameters.name: address

count.description: How many emails are in the inbox.

from.description: The sender exactly as the email shows it, name and address.

has_attachments.description: Whether the email came with attached files.

id.description: The email's ID, for reading it in full later.

latest_email_id.description: The newest email's ID, or empty when the inbox is empty.

read_email.description: Open one email in a temporary inbox and get its full text, its formatted version and every link in it. Leave the email blank to read the newest one. An empty inbox finishes with Found set to no instead of failing.

description: Make throwaway email addresses that receive real mail, with Best Temp Mail. Create a temporary inbox, use it to sign up for something or to test the emails your own product sends, then wait for the email to arrive and read it, links included, so a workflow can follow a confirmation link or pick out a code. Inboxes delete themselves after up to two hours, or delete one yourself when you are done. No account or API key required.
